criteria.criterion: Five keys exist: agent.plan, agent.work, agent.review, agent.gate-review, agent.verify; default claude; the only valid value is claude; environment variables VLOOP_AGENT_PLAN, VLOOP_AGENT_WORK, VLOOP_AGENT_REVIEW, VLOOP_AGENT_GATE_REVIEW, VLOOP_AGENT_VERIFY; `vloop config set` stores them under [agent] in .vloop/config.toml.
criteria.evidence: internal/config/config.go:91-95 adds the keys with Valid: agents; config_test.go TestAgentKeys checks default, env var name, and the [agent] table after Set

criteria.criterion: In a repository initialised by the changed binary with no [agent] table, `vloop config get agent.review` prints `claude` (exit 0) and `--json` prints {"key":"agent.review","value":"claude","source":"default"}.
criteria.evidence: default comes from Key.Default; the gate asserts these exact lines; TestDefaultsEveryRow covers the defaults

criteria.criterion: `vloop config set agent.review copilot` prints `vloop: invalid value "copilot" for agent.review: want one of claude` on stderr, exits 2 and leaves .vloop/config.toml byte-identical.
criteria.evidence: TestAgentKeys asserts the exact error text and an unchanged file; the existing InvalidValueError path is reused; the gate checks exit 2 and cmp

criteria.criterion: `VLOOP_AGENT_WORK=copilot vloop config list` prints `vloop: VLOOP_AGENT_WORK: invalid value "copilot" for agent.work: want one of claude` and exits 1; an invalid agent value in the environment or the file makes `vloop config get`, `vloop config list`, `vloop doctor` and `vloop run` exit 1, and `vloop run` starts no session.
criteria.evidence: TestAgentKeys checks SourceError for bad env and bad file in Get and List; TestResolveAgent shows ResolveRun rejects a bad value; the gate loops over all phases for get/list/doctor/run and passed

criteria.criterion: `vloop config list` shows each of the five keys as `agent.<phase>=claude (default)`, like every other key.
criteria.evidence: cmd/vloop/e2e_test.go and internal/cli/config_test.go expected output gain the five lines, in text and JSON

criteria.criterion: The agent of work, review and verify is resolved once in ResolveRun at run start; the agent of plan and gate-review is resolved per session, when their model and effort are. There is no per-task agent override and the state schema is unchanged.
criteria.evidence: internal/driver/resolve.go: ResolveRun fills the agent map for work/review/verify; ResolveAgent(root, kind) is the per-session resolver; no task field was added; the state schema is untouched

criteria.criterion: docs/guide/configuration.md has a table row for each of the five keys with default `claude` and its `VLOOP_AGENT_<PHASE>` variable.
criteria.evidence: docs/guide/configuration.md lines 31-35, plus the storage note naming [agent]

criteria.criterion: With every VLOOP_AGENT_* set to claude, a run hands claude exactly what the base binary's run hands it (the gate's comparison).
criteria.evidence: nothing in the diff changes how sessions are started or what they receive; the gate's compare against the base binary passed

criteria.criterion: Committed tests the checks run cover the new keys (default, environment, file, invalid value refused by set, source error) and the agent's resolution; a key or resolver shipped with no test that exercises it is a violation.
criteria.evidence: TestAgentKeys covers default, env, file, refused set and source errors; internal/driver/resolve_test.go TestResolveAgent covers ResolveRun and ResolveAgent; the go check exit is 0

notes: Earlier tests were changed only to add the five new list lines, which the contract requires (the new keys appear in config list). Nothing calls ResolveAgent per session yet; the brief leaves that to the seam task T2.
